WITH LocalFundedSchools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
),
SchoolDifferences AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s.DOC,
        (s.Enrollment - s.Enrollment) / s.Enrollment AS Difference
    FROM schools s
    JOIN LocalFundedSchools lfs ON s.CDSCode = lfs.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Enrollment IS NOT NULL AND s.Enrollment IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.DOC, s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN SchoolDifferences sd ON s.CDSCode = sd.CDSCode
WHERE sd.Difference > (SELECT AVG(Difference) FROM SchoolDifferences)
ORDER BY sd.Difference DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools

    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, ym.Consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID

),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM cte

    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date LIKE '2012%' OR Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
total_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date LIKE '2012%' OR Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
percentage_increase AS (
    SELECT
        yc.CustomerID,
        (yc.TotalConsumption - tc.TotalConsumption) / tc.TotalConsumption * 100 AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM yearly_consumption yc
    JOIN total_consumption tc ON yc.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
)
